title: Product image requirements (Seller Forums post)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Staff forum post by the account TaylorR_Amazon, undated (shown as about 11 months old, so roughly late 2025), cited under Decision 14 because Seller Central help pages need a login: main image on pure white (RGB 255,255,255); product fills 85% or more; at least 1,000 pixels on the longest side for zoom; JPEG, TIFF or PNG; RGB or CMYK; file name includes the product identifier; no added text, graphics or watermarks; the actual product, no illustrations; no props not included. Nothing on AI. Least sure source in this kit.

title: Product media types
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no date shown). PNG suggested, then JPEG, with TIFF, BMP, GIF, SVG, HEIC and WebP accepted; files under 20 MB; up to 5000 x 5000 pixels or 25 megapixels; 2048 x 2048 suggested for square product images; consistent aspect ratio on collection pages.

title: Media generation
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no date shown). AI file editor: replace a background with a colour or transparency, change background, setting, lighting or style from a prompt, extend a canvas; output about 1 megapixel; an invisible watermark that cannot be removed; Save as new keeps a separate file; Basic plan and up.

title: AI-powered tools
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Lists AI image tools (colour background, prompt-based image changes, the Tinker app) and cautions that AI outputs can contain errors, so sellers should review anything a tool creates or changes.

title: Image link [image_link]
supports: Opened with WebFetch. At least 500 x 500 pixels for all products from 31 Jan 2027; 1500 x 1500 recommended; up to 64 megapixels and 16 MB; JPEG, WebP, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF; no promotional overlays, watermarks, added logos, placeholders, borders; product fills 75% to 90%; one variant per image; generative AI images must keep metadata such as IPTC DigitalSourceType, including Product Studio images.

title: Additional image link [additional_image_link]
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Up to 10 additional images (angles, in use, parts, bundles); same 500 x 500 minimum from 31 Jan 2027; undersized images not shown but product not disapproved; AI metadata must be kept.

title: Lifestyle image link [lifestyle_image_link]
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Up to 5 lifestyle images in real-world settings for free listings; at least 600 x 600 pixels; no promotional text, logos or padding; AI metadata must be kept; a changed image needs a new URL, and re-using the same URL can take up to 6 weeks to update.

title: Automatic image improvements
supports: Opened with WebFetch. When switched on, Merchant Center tries to remove promotional text, watermarks, overlays and logos from flagged images; turned off by default; set under Products, Automations.

title: Requirements and Best Practices for Images in Your Etsy Shop
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no date shown). At least 2000 pixels each side recommended; first photo at least 635 pixels, landscape or square; at least one unedited photo of the actual item against a real background; AI and other edits allowed for lighting, colour, cropping and backgrounds but not to hide flaws or misrepresent; suggests noting edits in the listing description.

title: Digital Source Type vocabulary
supports: Opened with WebFetch (latest concept change 2024-10-23). Terms including digitalCapture, compositeWithTrainedAlgorithmicMedia (edited using generative AI, such as inpainting or outpainting), trainedAlgorithmicMedia (created using generative AI), compositeSynthetic, algorithmicallyEnhanced (sharpening, noise reduction) and humanEdits.

title: C2PA: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Open technical standard, Content Credentials, to establish the origin and edits of digital content; specification 2.3 linked; steering committee includes Adobe, Amazon, BBC, Google, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Publicis Groupe, Sony, TikTok and Truepic.

title: Article 50: Transparency Obligations for Providers and Deployers of Certain AI Systems
supports: Opened with WebFetch. An unofficial reproduction of the Act, used because EUR-Lex returned no text to WebFetch. Providers mark synthetic image output machine-readably, except assistive standard editing that does not substantially alter input; deployers disclose deep fakes (content resembling existing persons, objects, places or events that would falsely appear authentic); applies from 2 Aug 2026.

title: Advertising FAQs: A Guide for Small Business
supports: Opened with WebFetch (April 2001, edited January 2025). Ads must be truthful and not deceptive; a reasonable basis is needed before the ad runs; express and implied claims; the FTC reads ads in context, including words, phrases and pictures.

title: Unfair commercial practices (CMA207)
supports: Opened with WebFetch (first 100,000 characters read). Guidance under the DMCC Act 2024, first published 4 Apr 2025, updated 18 Nov 2025: misleading actions judged on the overall presentation of a practice, even when individual statements are true.

title: Unfair commercial practices
supports: Opened with WebFetch (last checked by the EU on 28/04/2026). EU consumers are protected from practices that mislead by action (false information) or omission (leaving out important information).

title: Copyright Office Releases Part 2 of Artificial Intelligence Report (NewsNet 1060)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. 29 Jan 2025: the mere provision of prompts is not enough for protection; human expressive elements perceptible in the output, or creative arrangements or modifications of it, can be protected; AI assistance does not bar protection of human work.

title: Circular 30: Works Made for Hire
supports: Opened with WebFetch; PDF text extracted locally (revised 08/2024). A work is made for hire only when made by an employee within the scope of employment, or when specially ordered or commissioned in one of nine categories with a written agreement signed by both parties; then the hiring party is the author and owner.

title: License and sell your copyright
supports: Opened with WebFetch. A copyright owner can license use of a work or sell or transfer the copyright; a sale or transfer needs a signed document (an assignment).

title: Images Tutorial
supports: Opened with WebFetch (updated 8 Apr 2026). Informative images need a short text alternative; decorative images get empty alt text; images of text repeat the words; complex images need a full text version.

title: CSS Color Module Level 4
supports: Opened with WebFetch (Candidate Recommendation Draft, 3 Nov 2026). Section 3.5: untagged images, with no colour profile, must be treated as sRGB.

title: Photos as Web Content
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Jakob Nielsen, 31 Oct 2010, last reviewed 13 Aug 2026: users study information-carrying images such as product photos and ignore decorative stock photos; enlarged product photos should be at least twice as big as the original.

title: UX Guidelines for Ecommerce Product Pages
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Katie Sherwin, 24 Nov 2019: one product view is rarely enough; shoppers value multiple views, close-up detail and the product in use; an enlarged view is a must-have.

title: Product Page UX: All Products Need at Least One ‘In Scale’ Image (28% Get It Wrong)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Christian Holst, 30 May 2017: 42% of users tried to judge product size from images; 28% of 60 large ecommerce sites had no in-scale images; cut-out images alone led to wrong size conclusions.

title: 25% of E-Commerce Sites Don’t Have Product Images with Sufficient Resolution or Level of Zoom
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Edward Scott, 2 Apr 2020: 56% of users first explored images on product pages; 25% of sites had images that did not support visual exploration, 14% low resolution, 11% insufficient zoom.

title: Light — Science & Magic: An Introduction to Photographic Lighting (6th edition)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Hunter, Biver, Fuqua and Reid, 2021: theory and practice of photographic lighting; diffuse and direct reflection and the family of angles; lighting surfaces, metal, glass, liquids, white-on-white and black-on-black subjects.
